Test Case 3: DRY Principles Validation

Input: Check configuration cascading

Expected Output:
- common.values.yaml exists and provides baseline config
- local.values.yaml exists and contains only local-specific overrides
- Environment-specific files do NOT duplicate common config
- Single helmfile.yaml.gotmpl works across all environments

Validation:
- Verifies DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) principle implementation
- common.values.yaml should define defaults
- local.values.yaml should only override what differs
- No duplication of configuration across environment files
- Configuration is environment-agnostic with externalized values
